reason: This is a cleared government-services (SETA/staff-augmentation) contractor billing seats onto NGA program offices — its own pack description is 'provides geospatial intelligence (GEOINT) program management and systems engineering services to government agencies (NGA/NSG/ASG)' — which puts it on the wrong side of Barry Hess's market twice over: it is not a Series A/B venture-funded product startup of 8-30 people with a prototype stuck between demo and fielding, and the services it sells (acquisition program management, lifecycle-engineering guidance to the government, 'align technical requirements with acquisition strategies') are the same services Barry sells, making it a competitor rather than a buyer; every matched posting is verbatim boilerplate from a recompeted NGA test-and-evaluation/acquisition-support contract ('Refer to Section 3.3.3: NGA Test Organization (NTO) for a listing of expected work activities'), i.e. cleared billet backfill on an existing period of performance, not a confession of a lab-to-field transition stall — no quotable line redescribes the pain Barry fixes. Exa could not resolve the legal entity behind Paylocity job IDs 4203995/734820/1787589/4264895: at least six small cleared firms (Integrity Technology Consultants, Assured Consulting Solutions, Allen Integrated Solutions, Compatible Technology Solutions, AFORGE, Core-CSI) publish this identical JD text, so the employer name is unverified — but the drop holds for any of them, since all are the same business model.
